parsed.notes: The 2025 Credit Agreement has two financial covenants: a maximum consolidated total leverage ratio and a minimum fixed charge coverage ratio. The excerpt gives no limit or actual value for either, only that the company was in compliance with all covenants as of September 30, 2026, and had no outstanding borrowings. The 1.75 to 1.00 consolidated total leverage ratio and the $30.0 million minimum liquidity are left out. They are conditions for repurchasing shares and making other restricted payments, not maintenance covenants. The leverage-based ranges for the interest margin and commitment fee are also left out, since they only set pricing.
